name: Pali

routes.httpStatus: web discovery result; direct curl timed out after 20 seconds
routes.outcome: Official Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha viewer identified as the state cadastral-map route. No current HTML/JavaScript configuration or parcel response was recovered in the bounded request.

Official Rajasthan Apna Khata route describes Jamabandi copies and links to Bhu-Naksha. It is revenue-record/procedure evidence, not a recovered anonymous parcel geometry response; owner and other unsafe fields were not requested.

Official Urban GIS portal HTML fetched. The public UI exposes Khasra Search, View On Map, and View Khasra Info, and states that khasra and village boundaries come from the Settlement Department; no parcel feature response was embedded in the page.

Current public configuration inspected. It exposes ArcGIS REST service families on gisprod.rajasthan.gov.in, including a JDA Settlement_JDA Khasra layer and village layer. The configuration is generic/statewide and does not itself prove Pali coverage.

Current viewer JavaScript inspected. It uses ArcGIS FeatureLayer queryFeatures with returnGeometry=true and safe-looking parcel fields such as LG_CODE, TEHSIL_LGCODE, VILL_LGCODE, VILL_NIC_CODE, and KID for Khasra queries. No owner/address/titleholder query was executed.
Bounded ArcGIS Khasra-layer metadata request did not return. Schema, geometry type, CRS, and service extent therefore remain unverified.
Bounded ArcGIS village-layer metadata request did not return. No district/tehsil/village code could be safely resolved for a Pali parcel query.
Bounded district-layer metadata request did not return. This is a reachability limitation, not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
Official UIT Pali page was identified and provides local urban-agency context, but its public content did not expose a parcel API or safe parcel geometry response.

schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed. The code references KID and administrative village codes, but no returned feature established which field is the stable parcel identity.

UIT Pali is local urban-agency context, while Rajasthan Revenue/Settlement services are state custodians; no local Pali parcel response was qualified, so registryFound remains null.

uncertainty: Rajasthan's official Bhu-Naksha, Apna Khata, Rajdharaa Urban GIS, and UIT Pali routes are clearly evidenced. Anonymous reachability of the public ArcGIS layers, Pali-specific layer coverage, schema, CRS, stable native identity, spatial coverage, and update cadence remain unverified.
